# JDG-3634 (5)/(6) etc. = item numbers inside one ruling row; "priority 21" = row 21 of the rule-priority table (JDG-3638, text in studies/76-grs-json-beta-shape/terms/grs-json-review-request-4.md section 5).
# (a) Schema type names fixed by the rulings

# TaskStyle, CommentBoxStyle, HighlightBoxStyle, TaskGroupStyle (JDG-3699, "owner type + Style"); ShapeStyle {fill, stroke} (JDG-3610, kept by JDG-3699); Paint {color, opacityPercent} and Stroke {color, opacityPercent, widthPx} (JDG-3607); Editor (JDG-3700, was Writer); ImportOrigin (JDG-3710, was TaskOrigin); DocumentStamp and ChangeLogEntry (JDG-3712); TaskGroupColor (JDG-3733, was LaneColor/BandColor); Color (JDG-3260/3310/3563); ColorSide (JDG-3523, value -> hexColor; the type name itself is not re-ruled and the trees no longer show it); PredecessorLink (JDG-3604, was Dependency); LeaderTarget (named with the key leaderTarget in JDG-3556/3710; fallback type LeaderAnchorFallback dropped by JDG-3547); TaskTableWindow and ResourceTableWindow (JDG-3620); ColumnFilter, ColumnSort (JDG-3522); ColumnKey (JDG-3514, now only an enum of column names); UtcOffset (JDG-3514), UtcInstant (JDG-3521), Day, DateTime, Time (JDG-3521); entity names Project (JDG-3569), Calendar, WeekDay, Exception, WorkingTime (JDG-3550), Task, Resource, Assignment (JDG-3553), TaskGroup (JDG-3554), BaselineTask (JDG-3706), CommentBox (JDG-3371), HighlightBox (JDG-3528).

# Names retired: TaskVisual/TaskGraphicStyle (JDG-3384 -> JDG-3699), Writer, TaskOrigin, LaneColor, Dependency, CommentBoxAnchor/LeaderAnchor/LeaderAnchorFallback, TaskGroupMember (JDG-3614), PassthroughValues/PassthroughElement (JDG-3606), taskGroupTreeView (JDG-3697).
# (b) Rulings on $defs names for entities and types

# JDG-3699: the style types are named for the schema's $defs ("TaskStyle..." are $defs names); a type without a name was rejected because AI and developers could not look the type up by name with readSchema.
# JDG-3710 and JDG-3556: a type name matches its key name (importOrigin -> ImportOrigin, leaderTarget -> LeaderTarget).
# JDG-3604: one dependency's type is PredecessorLink; the Agent API readSchema example type names were changed with it.
# JDG-3638 priority 6 / N-1: keys camelCase, type names PascalCase. JDG-3716 P-9 (commands and Agent API): a field's type is the field name in PascalCase.

# JDG-3755: shared type definitions in the schema go look-group then table-group, smaller first: Color, TaskGroupColor, Paint, Stroke, ShapeStyle, ColumnFilter, ColumnSort, TaskTableWindow, ResourceTableWindow.

# JDG-3331: the value-format rules live in $defs/DateTime, $defs/UtcInstant, $defs/Day, $defs/Color and $defs/ColorSide (names from 2026-10-25). No ruling fixes a $defs name for the root parts (documentSettings, scheduleData) or for the passthrough wrapper objects.
# (c) required and "a key with no value is not written"

# JDG-3286 (all GRS keys required, no null) was partly overturned by JDG-3309: "no value" is said only by not writing the key, as in MSPDI; {"kind":"none"} is not used; always-valued fields are required and a missing one is refused; only "follows something else" states are written with type (theme, sameAsScheduleData, automatic); an omittable key's description says in one line what absence looks like; empty arrays are not written.
# JDG-3310: an absent color key = not drawn; box fills always hold a color, so that key is required. JDG-3526: opacityPercent omitted = 100.
# JDG-3339: one root-description line only: "A property with no value is omitted: null and [] are never written."; arrays carry minItems 1 and stay out of required.

# JDG-3616 N-15 (empty arrays also omitted), N-17 (a type-discriminated object writes only its variant's keys); JDG-3622 (3): an object whose contents are all absent is omitted too; N-12: null is never used.

# JDG-3634 (4) = priority 21 (JDG-3638): required holds only what the file cannot be read without. JDG-3650 (3): a discriminator type is required inside its object. JDG-3650 (4): dangling references and parent cycles refuse the file.
# JDG-3652: value-writing rules (no null, no empty, date formats) go into each property's description, not into a list at the top.

# JDG-3669: automaticallyShownDepth is always written by GRS but a file without it is not refused (Fit decides). JDG-3685: showMode optional with schema default "automatic", file not refused. JDG-3740: lastEditedBy always written, even for an untouched template. FR-024 (spec): settings are written even when equal to the default; JDG-3302: a written default does not follow later product defaults.
